subject: general
question: Which type of spindle drive motor is preferred in CNC machine tools due to advancements in microprocessor-based technology?
solution:
The correct answer is __Three-phase AC induction motor**(Option 1)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Three-phase AC induction motor__ is widely preferred in CNC machine tools.
 
• These motors offer greater efficiency and better control due to advancements in microprocessor-based technology.
 
• They are known for their high reliability, low maintenance, and versatility.
 
• Three-phase AC induction motors are capable of precise speed regulation when combined with modern electronic drives.
 
• They are ideal for applications requiring high torque and smooth operation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Single-phase AC synchronous motor:**

 
 
• Used in applications requiring precise timing but limited to lower power applications.
 
• Not commonly used in CNC machines due to lower efficiency and power output.
 
 
 
• **Separately excited DC shunt motor: **
 
 
• Offers good speed regulation but requires more maintenance.
 
• Less preferred in modern CNC machines due to advancements in AC technology.
 
 
 
• **Series excited DC motor:**
 
 
• High starting torque but poor speed regulation.
 
• Limited usage in CNC tools compared to AC motors.
